verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair privacy question for any service that holds user data, including a government filing portal with accounts, email notifications and prepaid accounts. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents user-controllable retention settings, deletion requests, or a retention policy. The items cover business filings, searches, open-data access and email signups, none of which address controlling retention or deletion.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
